bundle.shortDescription: Consent-first messaging for SMS, WhatsApp & Email: double opt-in, proof logged, STOP honoured instantly.
bundle.longDescription: Opt-In Message is a free, open-source, consent-first messaging app for SMS, WhatsApp and Email. Download, install, open — it just works. No extra software to install, no setup, no account: the whole app runs on your device and your data stays on your device. Contacts must complete double opt-in before they can receive anything, every subscription keeps a saved consent proof, campaigns are risk-checked and cannot send until a human approves them, and anyone who replies STOP is excluded permanently. Sending in this Simple App edition is simulated (a delivery log, no real messages); a self-hosted server edition for real sending lives in the same open-source repo. Free and open source (MIT).
